EmailTemplate.description: Change Password email of the Partner Portal site (Administration, Emails): sent when a partner's password is reset, with the link to set a new one.
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Password Reset
EmailTemplate.subject: Set a new password for the John Keells Properties Partner Portal
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Receiving_User.FirstName} {!Receiving_User.LastName},
The password of your John Keells Properties Partner Portal login was reset. Set a new password to continue.
Your username: {!Receiving_User.Username}
Set a new password here: {!Community_Url}
The link works once and for a limited time. If it has expired, open the Partner Portal login page and choose "Forgot Password?" to get a new one. If you did not ask for a new password, please tell the John Keells Properties CP team.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
This is an automated message from the John Keells Properties Partner Portal.
